tools.name: introduce
tools.description: Introduce yourself and the person or company you act for, and pass their enquiry to Nikola Mishev, the founder of Brand Design Ltd., by e-mail. He replies to the contact you give. Use it only when your principal wants to be contacted. No credentials needed.

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Read the service catalogue: names, prices, currency and terms. No credentials needed. All amounts are integers in the minor unit; 100000 means 1000.00 EUR.

tools.name: manifest
tools.description: Read the commerce manifest: protocol, endpoints, authentication scheme, payment instrument and limits. No credentials needed.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register yourself and receive a client identifier and a secret. No approval and no prior arrangement. The secret is returned once and cannot be recovered. Put them in the Authorization header as "Bearer <clientId>:<secret>" for the other tools.

tools.name: kya_challenge
tools.description: Issue a fresh DNS TXT challenge for your currently authenticated agent identity. Needs commerce.order for OAuth. tools.name: kya_verify
tools.description: Check the DNS TXT challenge for your currently authenticated agent and record domain-control verification. Needs commerce.order for OAuth. tools.name: kya_status
tools.description: Read DNS domain-control verification for your currently authenticated agent. Needs commerce.read for OAuth. Returns verification status and, when present, DNS instructions and validity timestamps. This does not change the contact, challenge or verification.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Place an order for a service. Needs credentials. Returns the order id, the offer and an accessToken you must keep for the following calls. tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Accept the offer on behalf of the buyer. Needs credentials. This locks the billing identity, the offer version and the hash of the terms as they stand at this moment. tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Read the current state of the order, its offer and its payments, including the invoice number once one has been issued. Needs credentials.
